description: Large-batch export of calls (POST /v1/query/export). Higher limit than query_calls (per-plan max records: Free 1000 / Pro 50000); available on all plans. Filter axes = startTime / endTime / provider / model plus limit. Example phrasing: "pull all of last month's GPT-4 calls and analyze the trends" — one call. The result format is the same JSON as query_calls (the AI can feed it straight into CSV / statistics).

endTime.description: Range end ISO timestamp (UTC; omit = now)

limit.description: Cap on returned records. Passed through when within the plan max; clamped to the plan max beyond it

model.description: Model name filter (exact match, no substring matching; e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini')

provider.description: Provider filter (openai / anthropic / gemini / mistral / xai / moonshot / deepseek / alibaba / meta)

startTime.description: Range start ISO timestamp (UTC; omit = all time)

name: export_calls
